description: Elections Commission - M. R. M. Udaya Bandara was selected as the member of the Rambukkana Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of the Rambukkana Pradeshiya Sabha (a local authority) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. The content specifically deals with electoral processes at the local government level, including the resignation of a member and the subsequent nomination and declaration of a new member to fill the vacancy by the Returning Officer. This falls squarely under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters.
